## What's Changed

* The menu item now follows the Windows display language. Turkish Windows shows **Masaüstüne kısayol oluştur**; other languages show **Create desktop shortcut**.

Extract the ZIP below and run `Install.cmd` to update.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Despical/SearchDesktopShortcut/compare/v1.0.1...v1.0.2
